name: Leave Register
query:
SELECT
  la.name AS `Reference`,
  la.employee AS `Employee`,
  la.leave_type AS `Leave Type`,
  la.from_date AS `From Date`,
  la.to_date AS `To Date`,
  la.total_leave_days AS `Total Days`,
  la.status AS `Status`
FROM `tabLeave Application` la
WHERE (%(employee)s IS NULL OR %(employee)s = '' OR la.employee = %(employee)s)
  AND (%(status)s IS NULL OR %(status)s = '' OR la.status = %(status)s)
  AND (%(year)s IS NULL OR %(year)s = '' OR YEAR(la.from_date) = %(year)s)
ORDER BY la.from_date DESC
